title: Adonai Mitchell ‘excited’ to have full offseason in Jets’ system after midseason trade

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Adonai Mitchell ‘excited’ to have full offseason in Jets’ system after midseason trade
sources.description: Adonai Mitchell did not have much time to get acclimated to the Jets last season before he started catching passes. That's not the case this year.
